LifeTrack Clinic: the doctor app's name and icon

The patient app already ships this icon. It was added on 30 Sep 2026, and I missed it in round 1. The doctor app still uses Flutter's default blue icon. Round 1's styles are replaced by three doctor options drawn from this logo.

Option 1, made from the real artwork: the patient app's deck with ℞ on the front card. The pulse line forms the ℞'s cross stroke and ends in the lime "now" dot.

Doctor app: three options in the same style

These are flat sketches. The patient logo is a rendered image with glass and glow, so the chosen option would be redrawn to match it exactly. A doctor will often have both apps on one phone, so each option is judged on how easy it is to tell from the patient icon at a glance.

Option 1

Same deck, ℞ on top

The same three cards, but the front card shows the prescription sign, with the pulse and lime dot running underneath it.

  • Clearly part of the same family.
  • The outline is the same as the patient icon. At 28 px the two look almost identical, which matters because many doctors will have both installed.
Option 2

Same deck, stethoscope pulse

The patient logo with one change: the pulse runs off the front card and drops into a lime stethoscope chestpiece.

  • The connection reads well: the patient's pulse reaches the doctor.
  • The difference is a small lime hook on the right. It's visible at 56 px but faint at 28 px.
Option 3

One card, stethoscope pulse

recommended

A single upright card in the same frosted glass. A black pulse line runs across it and drops into a chestpiece whose centre is the lime "now" dot. The patient holds the whole deck; the doctor sees one card at a time, shared and then closed.

  • The outline differs from the patient icon (one upright card instead of a fan), so the two can't be confused even at 28 px.
  • Same glass, same near-black background, same lime dot: obviously the same family.
  • It also matches what the doctor actually gets: a share that closes when access ends.

Rules every option follows

  • No red cross. In India, the Geneva Conventions Act 1960 restricts the Red Cross emblem, including red plus signs on white.
  • Names promise nothing the app doesn't do. No "Vault", "Records" or "Verified" (rules 1d and 15).
  • Lime stays "now". In both icons it marks only the point where the pulse arrives.
  • Fits Android's icon mask. Each mark stays inside the central 66%, so it survives circle and squircle masks.
